message.content: Apple Inc. closed at 316.22 within a trading range bounded by immediate support edges between 310.66 and 323.67 and immediate resistance at 330.81, while the 50-day average of 316.34 sits just above the close and the 20-day average of 314.10 remains below it. The stock has beaten estimates for eight consecutive quarters with an operating margin of 32.6 per cent that is higher than the 30.0 per cent recorded a year earlier, reflecting sustained profitability over ten quarters on the same side of the prior year level. Sales growth of the same quarter a year before reached 9.6 per cent against a backdrop where sales growth on a year earlier was 16.4 per cent and 16.6 per cent in the quarter before that. Technical indicators show a relative strength index of 50.26 and a MACD of 1.91 above its signal line of 1.44, suggesting neutral momentum as the business state is improving toward the 2026-06-30 reading.
